titles.title: Khi Cánh Cửa Đó Mở Ra, Là Anh
The One Who Comes Through the Door
When That Door Opens, It's You
When the Door Opens, You'll Be There
When You Walk Through That Door

description:
Yvonne, who lives by running a small clothing shop on her own,
meets Jérôme—a blood-covered, beautiful man who walks through her shop door on a rainy day.

Captivated and falling in love with his alluring charm,
she continues her encounters with this secretive man who arrives at nightfall and vanishes before sunrise.

However, Jérôme's true identity and the secrets he has hidden begin to unfold one by one.
Tormented by the truth that reminds her of her own painful past, Yvonne still waits every night for Jérôme to open that door and come to her….

**"Now, I'm going to enter inside Yvonne."** He gave a sly, petulant smile. **"So don't run away. Feel it properly."**
